key_finding: website_sale_loyalty is the sole eCommerce loyalty integration module; coupon submission routes through /shop/pricelist -> _try_apply_code() with session-based error/success feedback; no pos_loyalty dependency; gift cards, eWallet, coupons, and loyalty all unified in this single module.

routes.purpose: Coupon code form submission; calls order._try_apply_code(promo); session-based error/success storage
Shareable coupon link handler; stores pending_coupon_code in session; applies immediately if cart exists
Customer explicitly claims a displayed reward; posts reward_id and coupon code
Triggers _update_programs_and_rewards and _auto_apply_rewards on every cart page load
eWallet top-up: adds trigger product to cart

payment_py.purpose: Re-evaluates rewards before transaction finalization; raises ValidationError if order total changed

delivery_py.purpose: Adds shipping discount and per-discount-reward amounts to delivery summary JSON for JS live update

portal_py.purpose: Adds published trigger products to loyalty card portal history values

new_fields: disabled_auto_rewards (Many2many loyalty.reward) — tracks customer-dismissed auto rewards
key_methods: _get_program_domain() — replaces sale_ok with ecommerce_ok for website orders
_compute_website_order_line() — merges discount lines per program for visual display
_get_claimable_and_showable_rewards() — extends claimable with partner's existing cards
_gc_abandoned_coupons() — autovacuum cleanup of abandoned cart coupons (default 4 days)
_allow_nominative_programs() — blocks nominative programs for public users

loyalty_rule.constraints: _constrains_code() — enforces per-website code uniqueness; blocks collision with loyalty.card codes

new_methods: action_coupon_share() — opens coupon.share wizard for specific card

overrides: _show_in_cart() — hides discount reward lines (replaced by merged visual lines)
unlink() — registers deleted reward in disabled_auto_rewards
_is_sellable() — reward lines not sellable (except free-product type)

returns.wrong_program_type: {'error': 'This program cannot be applied with code.'}

validation_logic.concurrency_guard: FOR UPDATE NOWAIT on loyalty_program row in PostgreSQL

gift_card_balance.note: No website_sale_gift_card module exists; gift cards handled within website_sale_loyalty

error_feedback.mechanism: session-based for pricelist route; URL query param for activate_coupon route
error_feedback.frontend: CouponToaster JS interaction converts hidden divs to browser notifications (success/danger/warning)

templates.reward_panel: modify_code_form — injects error/success alerts + claimable rewards loop with claim forms
templates.layout_extension: layout — injects hidden coupon message divs for JS toaster
templates.payment_confirmation: website_sale_purchased_gift_card — shows purchased gift card codes with copy button

javascript.checkout_js: Patches Checkout._updateCartSummary to update shipping/discount amounts from delivery JSON
javascript.coupon_toaster_js: CouponToaster interaction: converts hidden divs to notification toasts
javascript.gift_card_copy_js: GiftCardCopy: clipboard copy of gift card codes on confirmation page

wizard.purpose: Generates shareable coupon URLs; optionally creates short link via link.tracker
